description: Implementation of a specialized FFMPEG-based AudioDecoder class, including codec initialization, decoding, and resource management.

classes.name: AudioDecoderImpl<FFMPEG>
classes.description: FFMPEG-specific implementation of the AudioDecoder interface, handling codec setup, decoding, and resource management.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new FFMPEG-based AudioDecoder instance.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up output and error callback functions.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes input buffers into audio frames.

methods.name: ProcessDecodedFrame
methods.description: Processes a decoded AVFrame into internal audio data format.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the decoder.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state and resources.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the decoder is properly initialized and valid.

methods.name: GetSampleType
methods.description: Returns the sample type used by the decoder.

methods.name: GetStorageType
methods.description: Returns the storage type of the audio frames.

methods.name: InitializeCodec
methods.description: Allocates and configures the codec context for decoding.
